author_scope: Continue exploring the same three directions and give conjectural directions equal space; assess substantive value relative to actual recent OpenAI mathematical preprints.
deliverables: Exact useful follow-on theorem statements with analytical proofs or explicit missing lemmas
Equally visible conjectures with quantified scope, edge cases and falsification routes
Primary-literature provenance and a concrete contribution-quality comparison, not a ranking promise
Separate Lean targets/status and a source-reviewed public story note

directions.D1: Finite single canonical obligatory r-uniform atoms, r>=3; Levi cycle rank equals core cycle rank after actual carrier transport. Investigate the rank-three core boundary without assuming a counterexample exists or assembly closure.
directions.D2: Finite simple graph private expansion: every core edge gets r-2 distinct private vertices. Examine the exact m2-to-mr transformation and certificate generality; distinguish universal balancedness from positive Sidorenko excess/random-host consequences.
directions.D3: Finite normalized homomorphism densities and actual multi-port contraction. Examine complete rooted-profile conditions sufficient for assembly inequalities and whether the unrestricted claim has a concrete obstruction. Scalar densities are not substituted for joint profiles.

conventions: Finite simple uniform patterns; all homomorphisms; finite probability weights including zero masses; symmetric nonnegative bounded kernels for inequality claims, separately ordered algebraic kernels for identities; cycle rank e-v+c uses actual carriers. Definitions, universes, quantifiers and external premises remain explicit.
methods: Small inert counterexample diagnostics when justified
acceptance: A proof, finite numerical diagnostic, literature input and conjecture are labelled separately. No desired conclusion is assumed. Established external results are attributed rather than advertised as new; no kernel validation or novelty/journal-readiness claim without corresponding evidence.
resource_scope: One bounded source-only checkpoint in three parallel mathematical lanes plus a quality-comparison lane. No compiler/version/job/service request, broad automated search or expensive computation. Any later execution needs its own reviewed cumulative-budget/resource decision.
non_goals: No paid service or external-chat request
No private export or merge/main push
No promise to exceed an unspecified least valuable OpenAI result
confirmation_boundary: User confirmed equal space for conjectural directions. A substantially broader campaign, long-running computation, major code change or new external collaboration requires a new brief and confirmation.
